initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity portrait MOBILE WEB PAGE design direction for 银河AI知识图册, a Chinese concept reader with a real interactive 3D knowledge network. Only mobile, no desktop view, no phone hardware, no browser frame. The first screen must be mainly readable concept text, with a small clearly recognizable 3D relationship-network preview that opens immersive exploration, plus useful navigation/search. The preview should look spatial, with actual volumetric nodes and connected edges, not a flat icon or an unrelated illustration. Relation guidance lives in contextual hints and a small 怎么看 entry, not a separate explanatory panel. All concept IDs/internal numbers are hidden. Choose visual identity, colors, typography, materials, composition, and navigation freely. The brand name does not require a space-themed background or a dark palette. This is a usable learning reader, not a landing page. Avoid fabricated progress, scores or courses.
Show concept 大语言模型, English Large Language Model (LLM), cognition 理解.
Real definition: 在海量文本上训练、以预测词序列下一个单元为目标、具备语言生成与转换能力的大规模参数模型。
Real example: 能续写、改写、翻译、摘要的对话模型。
Real safety sentence: 模型可能生成不实信息，事实必须人工核查。
Provide on-demand reading entries for 案例、类比、误解、反例、深度、安全、来源, without squeezing every paragraph into the first screen. Useful actions: find a concept, explore the network, read adjacent concepts, return to the saved reading position. The current concept has 41 adjacent concepts. A network preview can show an illustrative readable subset. Model and next-token prediction are prerequisites of LLM; LLM is prerequisite of fine-tuning; pretraining and AIGC are undirected related concepts. Do not reverse those meanings or invent labels. Small labels can be simplified for legibility. UI text stays editable in eventual implementation; this is a visual reference only.

Concept 1: Make sustained, comfortable reading feel inviting. Develop an original visual language and reading rhythm, with the small spatial preview as a natural companion to the text. Decide the layout yourself.
